description: Step-year scans with supremum critical values, the ORAS5 joint model with steps at 2004 and 2015, the GLORYS12V1 2004 fit with Holm adjustment, and the reconciliation of the ORAS5 Argo-era trends.

conventions.pvalue_note: sup p values count the simulated null maxima at or above the observed maximum, with the +1 correction.

d_oras5_argo_reconciliation.note_step_2004: Over 2004 to 2025 the indicator I(t >= 2004) is identically one, so a 2004 step is absorbed by the intercept and is not identified in this window.
